2121981880949965283.en_summary: Locked in 75% of both. Got 120 plus points on $ZEC. Plan in markets like this is always to be a profit-taking maxi. Make a good hit, lock in most profits, keep a little to avoid fomo. Stay liquid for next opportunity, take small losses if something doesn’t work. Big losses will kill you.
